items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: Charles Rose... got called to do Paul McCartney in New York, do his album... We did six songs in six hours like that... Paul bought us lunch.

ctx.x: You play the parts by ear. Yes. Okay Paul McCartney, “Egypt Station” 2018. I was an honorary member of the Muscle Shoals Horns. I’d done a couple of gigs with the Muscle Shoals Horns in Muscle Shoals. The fortieth anniversary of the “Last Waltz” movie, a movie that I was in, we did it in Muscle Shoals with the Muscle Shoals Horns. And I presented at the Alabama Music Hall of Fame. I was inducted the Muscle Shoals horn © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-

section. So Charles Rose, the head of the section, he got called to do Paul McCartney in New York, do his album. And he didn’t know what they were going to play. They didn’t send him any music in advance, any charts, anything. They flew us out there and put us up at a hotel and said, “We’ll pick you up at 11:00.” We didn’t know where the session was. So we show up, they picked us up at 11 and we go to Henson’s Studios, it used to be A & M Studios, it used to be Charlie Chaplin’s studios. And Paul comes out and…
